findings.title: INTEGRATIONS.md marks Retell AI lifecycle as production when account does not exist — false operational status
findings.detail: INTEGRATIONS.md line 45 states `lifecycle: production (pending account creation D2)`. The phrase 'pending account creation' is an admission that the integration is not live, yet the lifecycle label is 'production'. Any AI worker or human reading this file will treat Retell as a production dependency and route real workload through it. The correct status is 'experimental' with a clear blocker reference. ADR-0011 governs this decision.
findings.fix_sketch: Change line 45 to: `lifecycle: experimental (account not yet created — blocked on M-005; see ADR-0011)`

findings.title: AGENTS.md section 1 omits spec-template from sibling repos list — AI workers are blind to its existence
findings.detail: AGENTS.md §1 lists only two sibling repos: IFleet and voice-discovery. The spec-template repo (github.com/weautomatehq1/spec-template) shipped in M-001 on 2026-05-16 and is the GitHub template used to spawn all per-client repos. Without it in the list, AI workers do not know spec-template exists, cannot cross-reference it, and may duplicate template work or miss spec-template breaking changes.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a third bullet under §1's sibling repos: `- \`github.com/weautomatehq1/spec-template\` — GitHub template used to spawn per-client repos (created M-001, 2026-05-16)`

findings.title: README.md 17-spec-files table includes CLAUDE.md as canonical spec file — contradicts AGENTS.md definition
findings.detail: README.md lines 34-53 present a table titled 'The 17 spec files' that contains 18 rows: the 16 spec docs, AGENTS.md, AND CLAUDE.md. Per AGENTS.md §2, CLAUDE.md is explicitly 'not a spec file; the canonical 17 spec files are items 1–16 above plus this file [AGENTS.md]; CLAUDE.md is included here as the Claude Code entry point, not counted in the 17'. A README that contradicts the primary AI rulebook creates immediate confusion for any worker reading the required-reading order.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a footnote dagger (†) to the CLAUDE.md row in the table and add a footnote at the bottom: '† Not one of the 17 canonical spec files — this is the Claude Code bridge (see AGENTS.md §2)'

findings.title: STATUS.md days-overdue counter inconsistency — one section shows 42 days where others show 48
findings.detail: .omc/STATUS.md has an 'Open questions' section at line 86 that reads '42 days overdue'. The 'In flight' section at line 47 and 'Up next' at line 68 consistently reference 48 days. All sections refer to the same overdue Retell account creation item. The 42 is likely a copy-paste artifact from an earlier update. A mismatch in the same status file loses trust and can cause Proposer misranking.
findings.fix_sketch: Change '42 days overdue' in the Open questions section to '48 days overdue (as of 2026-07-07)'

findings.title: NON_GOALS.md sprint header references completed sprint ending 2026-05-20 — stale by 49 days
findings.detail: NON_GOALS.md line 36 reads '## Non-Goals (this release — 5-day sprint ending 2026-05-20)'. Today is 2026-07-08, so this header is 49 days stale. The non-goals section was not re-evaluated when SPRINT-2026-05-A closed. Workers reading this file may incorrectly believe non-goals were scoped to that sprint window only.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the header to reference the current sprint cycle or remove the date constraint: '## Non-Goals (standing — last reviewed for sprint SPRINT-2026-05-A; pending SPRINT-2026-05-B re-evaluation)'

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md marks spec-template subgraph as '(new repo)' after M-001 shipped
findings.detail: ARCHITECTURE.md line 76 contains `subgraph template[" spec-template (new repo) "]`. M-001 shipped on 2026-05-16, creating the spec-template repo. '(new repo)' is no longer accurate and implies the repo is under construction when it is live and used for every client spawn.
findings.fix_sketch: Change `spec-template (new repo)` to `spec-template` in the subgraph label.

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md cross-cutting table missing OMC_KILLSWITCH env var
findings.detail: ARCHITECTURE.md §6 (cross-cutting table) documents killswitches including IFLEET_QUEUE_PAUSE, IFLEET_DISPATCH_DISABLE, and IFLEET_VERIFIER_DISABLE, but omits OMC_KILLSWITCH which is documented in other OMC scripts and used as the global emergency halt. A worker consulting the cross-cutting table for killswitch enumeration would not know OMC_KILLSWITCH exists.
findings.fix_sketch: Add OMC_KILLSWITCH to the killswitches row in the cross-cutting table with description: 'Global OMC emergency halt — stops all orchestration processes'

findings.title: ROADMAP.md Now section references stale sprint SPRINT-2026-05-A that completed 2026-05-20
findings.detail: ROADMAP.md §Now header still references 're-plan pending in SPRINT-2026-05-B; SPRINT-2026-05-A ran 2026-05-15 → 2026-05-20, incomplete'. No new sprint has started (status: living). The Now and Next headers need to reflect that no active sprint is running rather than pointing to a sprint that closed 49 days ago.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the Now section header to indicate no active sprint: '## Now (no active sprint — re-plan pending SPRINT-2026-05-B start; last sprint SPRINT-2026-05-A closed 2026-05-20)' and remove or update any inline sprint references in the section body.

findings.title: INTEGRATIONS.md Retell rate_limits still TBD after Esme R1 research — 48 days overdue
findings.detail: INTEGRATIONS.md line 40 reads `rate_limits: per Retell plan (TBD from Esme R1 research)`. The R1 research was scoped to be completed around the time of M-005 which was targeted at the original sprint. This item is 48 days overdue. Without knowing rate limits, the Proposer cannot estimate task slot sizing for Retell-backed tasks.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the rate_limits note to acknowledge the delay and add a blocker reference: `rate_limits: TBD — Esme R1 research 48 days overdue; blocked on account creation (M-005)`

findings.title: FILE_STRUCTURE.md and AGENTS.md directory trees both missing .audits directory
findings.detail: FILE_STRUCTURE.md lines 24-52 and AGENTS.md §3 both show the factory/ directory tree. Neither includes `.audits/` even though the directory exists and contains 15+ audit scan files and index.json. Any worker using these trees to understand repo layout will not know where audit artifacts live.
findings.fix_sketch: Add `.audits/` to both directory trees with comment `# nightly audit scan results (append-only)`

findings.title: ENV.md line 66 typo: 'Esmel' should be 'Esme'
findings.detail: ENV.md line 66 reads `DISCORD_USER_LABEL | Outgoing prefix (Sebas or Esmel)`. The team member's name is Esme, not Esmel. This is a plain typo.

findings.title: UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md IFleet entry uses local ~/dev path instead of GitHub URL
findings.detail: UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md line 43 reads 'Lives at ~/dev/ai-products/IFleet'. This is a local developer path, not portable. Workers running on VPS or in containers won't have the repo at that path. The canonical reference is the GitHub URL.

findings.title: NON_GOALS.md NoGo-1 references non-existent STAKEHOLDERS.md 'project overview' section
findings.detail: NON_GOALS.md line 89 reads 'see STAKEHOLDERS.md project overview'. STAKEHOLDERS.md does not have a 'project overview' section. The cross-reference is broken.
findings.fix_sketch: Change the reference to 'see AGENTS.md §1 and STAKEHOLDERS.md §Decision log (2026-05-15 entry)'

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md IFleet component labels use 'NEW: M-NNN' for shipped milestones
findings.detail: ARCHITECTURE.md lines 86-91 label multiple IFleet components as 'NEW: M-002', 'NEW: M-008', 'NEW: M-009', 'NEW: M-012', 'NEW: M-004'. These milestones have shipped. Labels should reflect actual status rather than treating every milestone as perpetually new.
findings.fix_sketch: Change 'NEW: M-NNN' labels to 'PLANNED: M-NNN' for milestones not yet started, or remove the tag entirely for milestones that have shipped.
